query:
SELECT 
  pc.id,
  pc.childProductId,
  pc.quantity,
  p.id as product_id,
  p.name as product_name
FROM productCompositions pc
LEFT JOIN products p ON pc.childProductId = p.id
WHERE pc.parentProductId = 990003
